label: TissueDefinition master dial (BARA_LESSONS A5)

provenance.anchors_note: endpoints are the orc sub-presets' authored tissue values [S, preset-orc-bara.md sections 3.1/3.2 as amended Nov 12, 2026]; pecs_crease at_driver_0 is [E] (strongman orc leaves it unset)

semantics: One dial expands into the tissue/definition family, linearly interpolating the two orc sub-presets' tissue vectors (dial 0 = orc_bara_strongman tissue, dial 1 = orc_bara_bodybuilder tissue). Fills only sliders the character has NOT set explicitly: explicit values always win.
